_about: Every SENTIENT environment setting that applies to a single Windows node. 'default' is SENTIENT's built-in value (the installer shows the value its engine writes instead, where the engine writes one), read from the code (master, 2026-10-15); empty means it has no fixed value. 'recommended' is what the installer writes when the operator keeps the recommended configuration. A setting is written to the service only when it has a value (recommended or typed); otherwise SENTIENT's default applies. Cluster-only and build/test variables are deliberately absent; secrets and the instance ID are generated by the installer.
